tools.description: Show the finished tool path as an image (top view and isometric view, cutting moves and rapids in different colours) so the user can sanity-check the job before paying. Free.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_upload_link" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a short-lived link the user opens in their browser to upload a CAD file (STEP, DXF or SVG). Returns the link and an upload_id. Poll check_upload with the…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
